Because the ztest thread runs at cooperative priority `-1` (`CONFIG_ZTEST_THREAD_PRIORITY`) while `treceiver` runs at lower priority `K_PRIO_PREEMPT(0)`, `k_yield()` did not allow `treceiver` to run and reset `test_event` before `k_event_post(&test_event, 0x123)` was called, causing `treceiver`'s subsequent `k_event_wait_all(..., reset=true, ...)` to wipe the newly posted `0x123` events. Replacing `k_yield()` with `k_sleep(DELAY)` (matching sync points 2-2, 2-3, and 2-4) allows `treceiver` to block and reset prior events before the new events are posted. All tests in `events_api` now pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
